post_topic: Scope discipline as a solo builder: why shipping constraints are actually engineering constraints
scene_description: A single developer sits alone at a desk late at night, a clock showing 10pm, with two monitors displaying code for a platform labeled 'Cloud Decoded' alongside an architecture diagram featuring HITL gates and LLM-agnostic routing nodes. On one side of the screen, a long backlog of feature ideas is visible; on the other, a drastically shorter list of items marked 'load-bearing' — HITL gates, LLM-agnostic routing, audit trail — with everything else struck through. The tension is between the sprawling complexity that could have been built and the disciplined, minimal system that remained after repeated cuts.
